text: Nobody cuts this screw's thread… it's pressed in.
sayTts: [mischievously] Nobody cuts this screw's thread... it's pressed in.

text: Goes in smooth… comes out threaded.
sayTts: [playfully] Goes in smooth... comes out threaded.

text: Wire, hammer blows, pressure… and a fourth detail that makes it stronger.
sayTts: [curious] Wire, hammer blows, pressure... and a fourth detail that makes it stronger.

text: It starts as steel wire: a blade chops it into little blanks.
sayTts: [thoughtful] It starts as steel wire: a blade chops it into little blanks.

text: Then, cold, it gets punched until the end swells into a head.
sayTts: [dramatic] Then, cold, it gets punched... until the end swells into a head.

text: Now the thread: it rolls between two steel dies that squeeze it.
sayTts: [excited] Now the thread: it rolls between two steel dies that squeeze it.

text: One pass… up to 500 a minute. Nobody gets tired here.
say: One pass… up to five hundred a minute. Nobody gets tired here.
sayTts: [chuckles] One pass... up to five hundred a minute. Nobody gets tired here.

text: Someone asked: why not just cut the thread, like always?
sayTts: [sarcastic] Someone asked: why not just cut the thread, like always?

comment.question: Why not just cut the thread like always? 🔩

text: Cutting removes steel and slices its fibers. Squeezing makes them follow the thread.
sayTts: [thoughtful] Cutting removes steel and slices its fibers. Squeezing makes them follow the thread.

text: That's the fourth detail: up to 30 % stronger, without losing a single gram.
say: That's the fourth detail: up to thirty percent stronger, without losing a single gram.
sayTts: [amazed] That's the fourth detail: up to thirty percent stronger... without losing a single gram.

text: Tag your friend who over-tightens absolutely everything.
sayTts: [excited] Tag your friend who over-tightens... absolutely everything.

text: See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
sayTts: [warmly] See you next time! Hit like and follow for more.
